content:
00: Villagers
Get Explorer to highest level you can (to 15 ideally), this will make all the caverns unlockable.
Get Engineer to ~25. There WILL be more engie upgrades, so get that if you want the upgrades early.
Get the Conjurer to the point where it would take you ~3 days to get another point, after that stop investing
Get the Measurer to ~13-14, this is less of a priority since the new measurement bonuses will probably use the new resources from the new resource cavern.

01: The Well
Unlock Rad Coral and Hyper Coral if you haven't already, they will probably be used in engie upgrades
Put one bucket per resource at night, this allows you to go to sleep and get maximum efficiency
02: The Motherlode
This probably won't affect or be affected by caverns 11-15. just get 20+ opals from it and ur fine
03: The Dawg Den
There is one more modifier coming the next update, it makes fear accumalate faster, so be prepared to redo it when the update comes out.
04: Bravery
Do it at least every other day for maximum efficiency. Prioritise villager exp.
05: The Bell
Save up a few Renews (renew progress does not deplete when you renew the bell so you can stack up renews) I would say 4 would be good. The bell will probably gain some new Ring bonuses which will buff the new caverns, make sure to renew when the update comes out.
You can Clean the bell multiple times to unlock improvement methods beyond 6 (they don't show on the screen). I am working on the 8th right now.
06: The Harp
Run D and G strings for EXP and opals
07: The Lamp
Save up your wishes! you'll need at least 12:
6 for resetting opals
6 for resetting cosmo points (you will need to not spec into idleon majick)
and there are two wishes you can save up to use when the update releases:
Bring Them Back for hours on the new statue
A Minor Discount for an easier time getting the new schematicsa
08: Fractalflies
Same as motherlode
09: The Gloomie Grotto
Same as motherlode
10: Justice
Same as Bravery, prioritise lamp wishes
